name: grimoire
description: Gives Claude the definitions of your own terms when a term comes up in the conversation, from a folder of Markdown files.

lorebook_dir.title: Lorebook folder
lorebook_dir.description: The folder of Markdown files holding your definitions, each entry a section whose header is the term.

ledger_dir.title: Inflected forms folder
ledger_dir.description: Where the terms' inflected forms are read from: Raven's expansion ledgers. Leave empty for Raven's own folder, ~/.config/raven/librarian/lorebook_expansion.

stem_languages.title: Languages matched by stem
stem_languages.description: Comma-separated, such as "Finnish, Estonian": languages whose stems are used as well as their whole-word forms, for languages that inflect too much to list every form. Leave empty for whole-word forms only.
